content.title: Noir Detective Credits | Comic Evidence Grid and Master-Title Resolution
content.summary: A lighthouse investigation uses tape, ferry logs and radar panels to build an original noir title. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One recurring evidence carrier opens the title system and remains traceable. + Every vignette uses the same limited palette and registered comic grid. + Credits are exact original text and occupy bounded readable regions. + Connections between clues remain visually causal rather than decorative clutter. + The master title contains miniature residues of the earlier evidence modules.
quick_start.recommended_input: Open on one black reel-to-reel tape carrying an original ivory lighthouse silhouette against darkness. Assign each vignette one fixed panel and one exact original credit card; no text crosses a panel boundary. Compress every panel into the exact master title "NIGHT SIGNAL" while lighthouse, ferry and archivist remain as small proof silhouettes.
required_anchors: One recurring evidence carrier opens the title system and remains traceable.
Every vignette uses the same limited palette and registered comic grid.
Connections between clues remain visually causal rather than decorative clutter.
The master title contains miniature residues of the earlier evidence modules.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: A lighthouse investigation uses tape, ferry logs and radar panels to build an original noir title. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: 以旋转唱片和侦探剪影建立母题，再让列车、便签、人物剪影和案件标签进入统一蓝橙紫漫画格；职员表与物证共用版式，终局归拢成可读总标题。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: One recurring evidence carrier opens the title system and remains traceable.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One recurring evidence carrier opens the title system and remains traceable."

invariants.rule: Every vignette uses the same limited palette and registered comic grid.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "Every vignette uses the same limited palette and registered comic grid."

invariants.rule: Credits are exact original text and occupy bounded readable regions.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "Credits are exact original text and occupy bounded readable regions."

invariants.rule: Connections between clues remain visually causal rather than decorative clutter.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "Connections between clues remain visually causal rather than decorative clutter."

invariants.rule: The master title contains miniature residues of the earlier evidence modules.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The master title contains miniature residues of the earlier evidence modules."

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: all source faces, bodies, wardrobe, identities and creator-specific character designs
the source location, set dressing, props, products and exact environmental geometry
all source words, logos, watermarks, typefaces and brand identifiers
the source choreography, exact camera path, shot durations and transition timing
the source palette, signature effects, prompt wording, creator handle and narrative particulars
